entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Ixalan people who use gnomes and refined them after capturing the technology from the Coin Empire.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Source from which the Oltec captured gnome technology.

entities.name: Eub Hlut
entities.description: Tiny people who inhabited the Foulmere long after the fall of Sarpadia.

entities.name: Peter Langwynd
entities.description: Naturalist who believed the Eub Hlut descended from the wood gnomes of ancient Havenwood.

entities.name: Shadow Gnomes
entities.description: Rarely seen gnomes of Yavimaya who bury the dead in strange burrows.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Founder of a Wizards' School on Ulgrotha where students built Clockwork Gnomes.

events.summary: The Oltec capture and reverse-engineer gnome technology from the Coin Empire at the end of the Night War.
events.quote: when they captured and reverse-engineered the technology to create them from the Coin Empire

relations.note: believed them descended from wood gnomes
relations.quote: The Naturalist Peter Langwynd believed them descended from the wood gnomes of ancient Havenwood
